purpose: Frozen pre-outcome execution manifest for the first formal D3.5 outcome exposure: the 4-arm x 6-case focused evidence-link recovery comparison over the frozen final repository D1 and the dedicated development materialization.
execution_head_subject: D3.5-A1-R3 freeze materialization receipt and lifecycle consistency

preflight_reverification.method: read-only exact repository-vs-database curated-state diff (D3.5-A1-R3 receipt generator, default_transaction_read_only=on connection)
preflight_reverification.result: matches_final_repository_d1 = true; all diff lists empty; stale_or_superseded_curated_records = 0; curated counts 24 / 16 / 1 / 2 unchanged

source_manifest_identity.note: identical to the manifest_hash of the active normalized corpus and the latest completed ingestion run

retrieval_index_identities.note: existing frozen index state reused; no rebuild, no reindex, no re-embedding

runtime_identity.preflight_drift_check: git diff 9b5a849 -- src/panda_agent/retrieval.py src/panda_agent/d3_structured.py configs/ is empty; no runtime, D1, or query-expansion change since the frozen final D1 commit

definitions.LEGACY: focused two legacy shortcuts ON; D3 structured treatment OFF; D3.5 bridge OFF
definitions.ABLATION: focused two legacy shortcuts OFF; D3 structured treatment OFF; D3.5 bridge OFF
definitions.STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED: focused two legacy shortcuts OFF; frozen pre-D3.5 structured path ON; D3.5 bridge OFF
definitions.STRUCTURED_BRIDGED: focused two legacy shortcuts OFF; frozen pre-D3.5 structured path ON; D3.5 bridge ON additively

frozen_arms.historical_non_interchangeability: historical D3 STRUCTURED ran on deployed 22/16/0 and is not interchangeable with STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED on the synchronized 24/16/1/2 materialization

focused_rule_treatment: exactly the two focused rules are suppressed in ABLATION, STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED, and STRUCTURED_BRIDGED; LEGACY keeps them active; all other query-expansion rules unchanged across all four arms

case_metadata.role: same subsystem with no governed evidence bridge required

frozen_cases.case_selection_policy: frozen in evaluation/d3_5_a0_structured_evidence_link_design.json (d3_5_a2_contract); no additions, substitutions, or omissions

execution_order_contract: deterministic case-major order: for each case in the frozen case order, execute LEGACY, ABLATION, STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED, STRUCTURED_BRIDGED once each; no cell rerun except per the existing evaluation runner infrastructure-failure policy; no reorder after outcomes begin

metric_definitions_reference.policy: existing frozen D3-A2 metric formulas reused verbatim; no redefinition; case-level tables always reported alongside aggregates

dependency_recovery_regression_classific.authority: D3-A2 frozen classification semantics (evaluation/d3_a2_three_arm_results.json R2-repaired layer separation)

causal_contrasts.shortcut_dependency: LEGACY - ABLATION = current synchronized-state shortcut dependency
causal_contrasts.unbridged_structured_contribution: STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED - ABLATION = contribution of final D1 + the pre-D3.5 structured mechanism
causal_contrasts.incremental_bridge_effect: STRUCTURED_BRIDGED - STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED = incremental causal contribution of the D3.5 bridge
causal_contrasts.final_legacy_parity: STRUCTURED_BRIDGED - LEGACY = final parity / regression / improvement relative to legacy
causal_contrasts.identifiability_boundary: STRUCTURED_BRIDGED - ABLATION is the combined final-D1 + old-structured + bridge contribution and must never be reported as a pure bridge effect

runtime_treatment_assertions.enforcement: D3_5ExperimentConfig.for_arm validates the exact frozen flag combinations; the retrieval plan diagnostics are validated against the config at retrieval time (d3 plan/config mismatch raises)

expected_evidence_boundary: expected evidence is consumed by the deterministic evaluator only after retrieval candidates are produced; never supplied to query analysis, D2 resolution, structured seed derivation, traversal, bridge materialization, candidate generation, or reranking (evaluation_metadata_runtime_use_count must remain 0)

database_freeze_during_execution.note: A2 may read PostgreSQL; the frozen development materialization must not change between cells
